adynamia.definition: n. lack of strength or vigor (especially from illness)
adynamia.translation:
n. 体力缺乏, 无力
[医] 动力缺失, 无力

adynamic.translation:
a. 无力的
[医] 动力缺失的, 无力的

adynamic fever.translation: [医] 无力性发热, 虚热, 衰弱性发热

adynaton.translation: [网络] 怪诞诗；不能；不可能比喻格

adyta.translation: n. 内殿, 内院；密室 (adytum的变形)

adytum.definition:
n. The innermost sanctuary or shrine in ancient temples,
   whence oracles were given. Hence: A private chamber; a sanctum.
adytum.translation: n. 内殿, 内院, 密室
